reviews.comment: Take him for CVEN 302!!! Best professor for this class. His lectures/notes are great, and he takes the time to work through problems in class. His homeworks are very similar to the exams. He is a very fair grader. Exams & the final were all open note & open book. If you put in a little work, an A is easy.

Professor Ying's first test was not difficult, but the 2nd test and the final were pretty difficult. Corona kind of changed his course. In the beginning the class was divided into 10 homework, a few in-class quizzes, and two midterms and a final.

Really cool and chill guy, recommend taking him! Exams are long so make sure you really know how to do the material. Labs are difficult and long, but just stay the whole lab and the TA's and prof will help you as much as you need. Lectures are really interesting and he is a good teacher.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Ying has no idea what he is doing. In the beginning he did lectures that were reading off slides (which was okay), but then he free lanced every lecture. I have to study his notes (that he doesnt even use ), Youtube, and the book just to stay afloat. His labs are easy, but if you want to know what you're learning, dont take this professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Qi is nice, but he is difficult to follow during lectures and sometimes lost track of what he was saying. Homework and computing lab assignments were a rollercoaster of varying difficulty, and his exams weren't the same format as other work done in the class. No clear grading rubric, but he gives extra credit and will correct inconsistencies.
